subject: Embedded Vision Summit
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your work on model training at [COMPANY] for
situational awareness and object detection. Noticed [NAME] Selinger is in SF
talking at the Embedded Vision Summit - so thought it'd be a great time to
connect if you're there too.

Quick context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (recently raised a
$30M Series B), working with teams like Verkada, Voxel AI, Milestone
Systems, Rhombus Systems, Intenseye, Protex AI in the CV/AI surveillance
space. Our platform brings together data curation, annotation, workflow
orchestration, and model evaluation, helping their AI teams scale faster as
their models and datasets grow in complexity.

Would you be open to a coffee with myself and our US Director, [SENDER], during
the Summit? We'll be around all three days. Happy to set something up
virtually if that's easier.
